name: TM Technology, Inc.
summary: TM Technology, Inc. functions as a fabless integrated circuit (IC) enterprise, focusing on the development, production, and distribution of diverse IC chips, their components, and associated items. Its product range includes LED drivers specifically engineered for green energy lighting applications, as well as an array of fiber optic and communications solutions. These communication offerings comprise laser diode drivers, limiting amplifiers, FTTx Passive Optical Network (PON) systems, transimpedance amplifiers, and digital diagnostics monitoring interface control solutions. The company additionally offers power management, audio processor, and both static and dynamic random access memory (RAM) chips, alongside providing technology consultation services for semiconductor products. Furthermore, TM Technology is active in the construction industry. The firm was founded in 1983 and maintains its principal offices in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
